_about: SELECTION STUDIO · module library B (buttons, glass cards, type). Built by modules/_build.py from modules/_src/. Every file is a standalone live module: ?acc=<slug> or postMessage({acc}) re-tints it, postMessage({cmd:'play'|'pause'}) runs it.
